lines.text: Moses had a whole list of reasons this wasn't his assignment.
And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
What you carry can look dangerous right before God is about to use it.
Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And it became a rod in his hand again.
The fear didn't leave. He just reached past it anyway.
What's in your hand was never too small. It was only waiting on obedience.
Throw it down. Pick it back up. Let God rename what's already yours. In Jesus' name, amen.

bold: It was only waiting on obedience
title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Throw It Down
story: A four-scene illustrated short film: a lone shepherd and his staff in the wilderness at dusk, the staff thrown to the ground and transforming into a serpent in a tense dark grove, a hand reaching back to grip the serpent as it turns back into a rod in breaking gold light, and the shepherd standing tall holding the rod aloft under a triumphant blue-gold dawn. A visual telling of Exodus 4:2-4 - the ordinary thing in your hand, surrendered and renamed by God.
